kybernos-modeleur.why: A developer script that renders a proof image to the OS temp folder; it is not part of the bundle's exports and never runs inside DSH.

kybernos-atlas.why: The only MutationObserver watches the map's own container to recolour its own nodes; it never reads or changes an element Atlas does not own.

kybernos-pulse.why: The `fetch(` calls are text inside the page script the host serves to the Mac app's web view; they run in that page, against its own host (connect-src 'self'). The host code makes no request.
A build-time script of the Mac menu-bar app: it paints the app icon and turns it into an .icns when the app is built. It is not an export of the bundle and never runs inside DSH.

kybernos-webapp-creator.why: Browser code of the hosted team space: the `fetch(` calls run in the person's browser against the app's own origin (connect-src falls back to default-src 'self'). The host code makes no request.
